original_question: Twenty dozen cups cost $1200 less than the total cost of half a dozen plates sold at $6000 each. Calculate the total cost of buying each cup.
question_template: {num_text_1, Twenty} dozen cups cost ${num_digit_1, 1200} less than the total cost of {num_frac_1, half} a dozen plates sold at ${num_digit_2, 6000} each. Calculate the total cost of buying each cup.
question_solution: answer = (f1 * 12 * num_digit_2 - num_digit_1) / (f2 * 12)   # f1 is numeric value of num_frac_1, f2 is numeric value of num_text_1
